verdicts.explanation: The paper states the MD-calculated conductivity of P(EO-MO) is 1.515 (± 0.199) mS/cm, computed in this study. The simulations run at 353 K (about 80 °C), and the null secondary fields are correct because none are given for this material.
The paper cites ref [53] for the experimental P(EO-MO) value of 0.4 mS/cm, so literature_cited is the right origin. No measurement temperature is stated, so null is correct.

The 90 °C is written after 'PEO's 1.5 mS/cm', so it is unclear whether it applies to the 1.1 mS/cm value for P(2EO-MO). The introduction also gives a 1.1 mS/cm value for a different system (ref [18], room temperature with plasticizer), so the temperature for this record cannot be confirmed.
